desc: Ideation: derive exchange argument and monotonic feasibility condition using first K as tops and last K as bottoms.
Implement the binary search solution: read input, define feasible(K), binary search K in [0, N//2], output answer.
Run sample tests (N=6, N=3, N=24) to verify outputs 3, 0, 6.
Test edge cases: N=2, all equal, K=0, odd N, max values up to 1e9.
Optionally brute-force check on small random cases to confirm the exchange lemma and implementation.
